'''Lotek'k''', better known as the '''Terror From Beyond''', was a massive and mysterious multi-tentacled entity.

==History==
{{Quote|Enemy's closing in, Major. This thing's huge! It's got five--no, six arms! How should we proceed?|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Sheron]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Lotek'k was once banished beyond the reaches of the known galaxy by the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]]. It remained there until the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] when the [[Dread Masters]] went renegade and began a campaign of creating fear throughout the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Amongst their plans involved sending their agent [[Kephess]] to the Gree world of [[Asation]] in order to take control of the [[Grand Hypergate]]. With it, the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] began bringing countless nameless horrors onto the planet to terrorize it leading to the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] calling upon assistance from both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

Spacers from both factions managed to [[Raid on Asation|defeat]] Kephess but not before the [[Hypergate]] was activated whereupon the Dread Master [[Calphayus]] summoned forth the Terror From Beyond from its distant prison. The creature emerged partially from the rift in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] but was beaten back into the structure where the spacers had to dislodge the beast from its hold thus defeating it along with the threat to Asation.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Terror from Beyond is the fifth and final encounter in the operation Terror from Beyond,TOR game update 1.4 of the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="site">{{TORweb|url=gameupdates/1.4-terror-from-beyond|text=Game Update 1.4: Terror From Beyond}}</ref> Though the creature is only identified in-game as "The Terror from Beyond", the description of an in-game screenshot on the official website gives the name Lotek'k.<ref name="name">{{TORweb|url=info/media/screens/asation|text=Screenshot - Asation (3)}}</ref>
